Both start out in Cragrock Mines.","questSpencerDeepPurpleWaitingOn":"I\'m dreaming of a royal purple, neighbour, but Beetroot [[Beetroot]] only grows in Hearthdeep Village. Ruby at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!","questSpencerDeepPurpleCompleted":"Purple and gold, fit for a king! Wear this chestplate \u2014 it has kept three heads safe for years, and it will keep you standing longer.","questNightWatchUnavailableHint":"Not now. Come back after dark, when the work is real. I\'m preparing the patrol.","questNightWatchNudge":"Watch Dog is on duty at the dungeon portal. Go and see him.","questFurRunName":"Spare Lining","questFurRunDescription":"Tillie needs fur. My patrol coat has spare lining, and I keep the trimmings. Bring me 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] for the three of us and it\'s yours.","questFurRunDelivery":"Bring Watch Dog 12 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]","questFurRunErrandDescription":"Pull 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] at Tillie\'s Patch, the farm in the hub. Bring them to me at the dungeon portal and the fur is yours.","questFurRunReminder":"Not yet. {{remaining}} more Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], then we trade.","questFurRunCompleted":"Fair trade. Take the fur to Tillie, and stay warm out there.","questAncientWoodlandName":"The Ancient Woodland","questAncientWoodlandDescription":"Some of these maples still hold ancient wood. Look for logs that sparkle, low on the trunk. Bring me 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]].","questAncientWoodlandNotYet":"Not yet. Let the grove settle.","questAncientWoodlandNudge":"Timbertooth has work in the grove. Go and see him.","questAncientWoodlandErrandDescription":"Chop sparkling logs in Timbertooth Woods, behind me. Only you can see the sparkles. None near you? Try other trees.","questAncientWoodlandReminder":"{{remaining}} more Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]. Look low on the trunks for sparkles.","questAncientWoodlandCompleted":"Good. Old wood, well cut. These leggings are made from it. Light on the feet.","questAncientWoodlandDelivery":"Bring Timbertooth 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]","questAllGearedUpName":"All Geared Up","questAllGearedUpDescription":"Mini has strong opinions about armour. Put on a full set and let him look you over.","questAllGearedUpInspection":"Wear 5 armour pieces that pass Mini\'s inspection","questAllGearedUpErrand":"Dress for the duel! Wear a helmet, chestplate, gauntlets, leggings and boots, then show Mini. ","questAllGearedUpUnavailableHint":"A moment, my friend \u2014 Mini is still polishing his horns. Return shortly.","questAllGearedUpNudge":"Lorenzo says Mini is ready to inspect your armour, over at The Badlands.","questHardenedEvidenceName":"A Hardened Hunch","questHardenedEvidenceDescription":"I\'ve had troubling reports from the far end of The Badlands. Travellers say the Zombies there have skin like rock and fists that pound the ground hard enough to throw a person off their feet. Worse, they\'ve made a camp. Zombies wander; they don\'t settle. A wise hunter learns his quarry before he draws his blade. Bring me proof, duellist!","questHardenedEvidenceErrand":"Find the Hardened Zombies camped at the far end of The Badlands and take 3 Hardened Hearts from them. Step out of the ring when they pound the ground!","questHardenedEvidenceCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceHandInDescription":"Bring those Hardened Hearts back to me, duellist. I must see them with my own eyes!","questHardenedEvidenceReminder":"{{remaining}} more of those Hardened Hearts, duellist. If the travellers are right, I\'d rather know sooner than later.","questHardenedEvidenceCompleted":"Hard as rock, and still beating... The travellers were right. No ordinary Zombie grows a heart like this. Something out there is changing them, and I mean to find out what. Mini won\'t believe a word of it. You\'ve done the Hub a real service, duellist.","questHardenedResearchName":"Know Your Quarry","questHardenedResearchDescription":"Those Hardened Hearts have kept me up all night, duellist. Skin like rock, fists like hammers... Whatever hardens those Zombies, I mean to understand it, and perhaps to borrow it. That calls for research! Bring me samples from the Hardened Zombies, and from ordinary Zombies to compare. Do this, and I\'ll forge you something special.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentGather":"Defeat Hardened Zombies at the far end of The Badlands for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]. They flake off that rock-hard skin, and no other Zombie carries them.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDeliver":"Bring the 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]] back to me for study.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Iron Fragment [[Iron Fragment]]. Only the Hardened Zombies drop them, duellist.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCompleted":"Iron, flaked straight off their skin! But iron alone doesn\'t walk about. Something more is at work here.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCollect":"Collect 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do, though Hardened Zombies drop them more often.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDeliver":"Bring the 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]] back to me. Whatever you do, don\'t eat them!","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Brain [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCompleted":"Brains! Let\'s see what they\'ve been thinking.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCollect":"Collect 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], hardened or not. I need plenty to compare.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDeliver":"Bring the 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] back to me. Hold your nose!","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], duellist. Hardened or not, any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCompleted":"Every sample accounted for! Between these and those Hardened Hearts, I\'ve learned the magic that hardens them, and worked it into good iron. Behold, the Hardened Sword! Once Grubnik\'s had his fee, his cannons will fire you over, and an Iron Pickaxe [[Iron Pickaxe]] digs it out.","golemFarmerTradePrompt":"Trade 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]] for 2 Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] + 2 Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]], up to 10 times","golemFarmerTradeFull":"Make room for your Moonstone Explosives [[Moonstone Explosive]] and Mining Grenades [[Mining Grenade]] before we trade.","golemFarmerShearingOffer":"Meet my Goofy Golems! Shear me 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]] worth and you can keep every one.","golemFarmerShearingStepName":"Shear 3 Diamonds [[Diamond]] from the Goofy Golems","golemFarmerShearingStep":"Shear the herd in Glimmerdeep Hollow: set a Moonstone Explosive [[Moonstone Explosive]] down beside them and stand well back, throw a Mining Grenade [[Mining Grenade]] at them, or swing a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]. Every 9 flakes make 1 Diamond [[Diamond]]. Run out of explosives? I\'ll trade you 2 for every 3 Moonstone [[Moonstone]].","golemFarmerShearingReminder":"The herd\'s still carrying plenty. Get yourself one and I\'ll teach you the knack.","golemFarmerPickaxeCraftName":"Craft a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]]","golemFarmerPickaxeCraft":"Craft a Moonstone Pickaxe [[Moonstone Pickaxe]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]]. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell your spoils and pay him!","questIntoTheInfernosFreeDescription":"You\'ve earned this, duellist. Past the old frame at the far end of The Badlands lie the Wild Infernos, the desert where Mini and I grew up. Its Portal Guardian will let you through. Go on, the desert awaits!","questIntoTheInfernosMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questIntoTheInfernosMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell your spoils for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questIntoTheInfernosMarketLearned":"You\'ve met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questIntoTheInfernosPortal":"Use the red portal to the Wild Infernos","questIntoTheInfernosPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.","questIntoTheInfernosFreePortalDescription":"Step through the red portal at the far end of The Badlands to reach the Wild Infernos.","questIntoTheInfernosAshhorn":"Speak to Elder Ashborn in the outpost","questIntoTheInfernosAshhornDescription":"Find Elder Ashborn in Emberwatch Outpost, beside the portal, and tell him I sent you. He taught Mini and me everything we know, so mind your manners!","questIntoTheInfernosMeeting":"Lorenzo\'s student? Then you are welcome here, traveller. Humans and minotaurs share this outpost, the only safe ground for miles. The desert beyond our walls is cruel, but its fire is sacred. Walk it with respect.","questIntoTheReachName":"Into the Lantern Reach","questIntoTheReachDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, so see Up Dog at the hub\'s Market first. He\'ll help you sell your way there.","questIntoTheReachLearnedDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. Its Portal Guardian charges {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]] a head, and you know the Market already. Sell what you can spare and pay him!","questIntoTheReachFreeDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Past the grey portal at the end of my path lies the Lantern Reach, where I grew up. Its great lighthouse went dark years ago, and I\'ve never been back. The Portal Guardian will let you through. Go and see it for me.","questIntoTheReachMarket":"Visit Up Dog at the Market in the hub","questIntoTheReachMarketDescription":"Visit Up Dog at the hub\'s Market. He\'ll show you how to sell spare resources for [[Gold Coin]] towards the portal toll.","questIntoTheReachMarketLearned":"You\'ve met Up Dog already, so you know the Market. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questIntoTheReachPortal":"Use the blue portal to the Lantern Reach","questIntoTheReachPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachFreePortalDescription":"Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachKeeper":"Speak to Stinky at the lighthouse","questIntoTheReachKeeperDescription":"Follow the jetty from the harbour to the lighthouse on its rock. You\'ll smell old Stinky before you see him! Tell him Blubberbeard sent you, and that I\'m sorry.","questIntoTheReachMeeting":"Blubberbeard sent you? My old apprentice... Tell him there\'s nothing to forgive. Welcome to the Lantern Reach, friend. Everyone here calls me Stinky, and you\'ll soon smell why! The Lamp has been dark a long while, and the fish sleep deep without its light. But a good angler might just wake them.","keeperWickNothingToDo":"Sit a while and watch the water, friend. Upwind of me, if you like. Every ripple has a story.","keeperWickQuestGreeting":"Ah, a visitor! Come into the light, such as it is. Don\'t mind the flies, they\'re old friends.","keeperWickInventoryFull":"Your pack is full to the brim, friend. Make some room and come back.","lanternReachHush":"This water is still. Only small fry bite here until Stinky\'s lens shines on it.","questKeeperWickLensHandIn":"Ah, look at it glow! Thank you, friend.","questKeeperWickLensReport":"Report back to Stinky","questKelpwoodLensName":"The Kelpwood Lens","questKelpwoodLensDescription":"The lagoon fish still carry a little of the old light. Catch me a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]], a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]], an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]] and a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]] here in the lagoon, and their glow will relight the lens that faces Kelpwood.","questKelpwoodLensReportDescription":"Got all four? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questNothingToForgiveName":"Nothing to Forgive","questNothingToForgiveDescription":"The Lamp is waking at last, and its light reaches further every day. Would you carry a message for an old Keeper, friend? My apprentice never heard my answer. Tell Blubberbeard there\'s nothing to forgive, and that the Lamp burns again.","questNothingToForgiveTell":"Tell Blubberbeard in the Hub","questNothingToForgiveTellDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and give him Stinky\'s answer.","questNothingToForgiveCompleted":"He said that? Nothing to forgive... I\'ve carried that guilt since I was a lad, matey. And the Lamp burns again! Here, take these two Glowtide Flares I\'ve kept since I left. Light one over Reach water and think of an old Keeper.","questKelpwoodLensCompleted":"Look, friend! The west lens is burning again, and its beam has reached Kelpwood. The fish there are waking already. Take my old Tidelight Rod. Its line still holds a little of the Lamp\'s light, so fish bite on it quicker and two at a time more often.","questAmethystLensName":"The Amethyst Lens","questAmethystLensDescription":"Kelpwood is waking, and its big fish glow brighter than anything in the lagoon. Catch me a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]], a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]], a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]], a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]] and an Oarfish [[Oarfish]] in Kelpwood\'s water, west across the bridge, and we\'ll light the lens that faces the Amethyst shoals.","questAmethystLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questAmethystLensCompleted":"Two lenses lit! The east beam has reached the Amethyst shoals, and the crystals are humming. This Glowglass Rod has a chip of the Kelpwood lens for a float, and fish come to it sooner.","questMoonwellLensName":"The Moonwell Lens","questMoonwellLensDescription":"Now the lens that faces the Moonwell, where the oldest fish sleep. It needs the brightest catches in the Reach. Catch me an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]], a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]], a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]], a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]] and a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]] in the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge.","questMoonwellLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questMoonwellLensCompleted":"Three beams across the water, friend! The Moonwell is stirring at last. Take the Moonwell Rod. It\'s cut from amethyst and cooled in that very pool, and the deepest fish rise to it.","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfish":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]. A thin silver thing that glints when it turns. The lagoon is full of them.","questKelpwoodLensPolarflash":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]","questKelpwoodLensPolarflashDescription":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]. It still sparks a little in the lagoon\'s dark water. Quick on the hook!","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnow":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnowDescription":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]. Pale as mist, and the gentlest bite in the lagoon.","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouper":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouperDescription":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]. It hides on the lagoon floor and rarely bites, so be patient.","questAmethystLensArapaima":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]","questAmethystLensArapaimaDescription":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. Big and slow, with a back as green as the kelp it hides in.","questAmethystLensStingray":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]","questAmethystLensStingrayDescription":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]. It glides low through the mangrove roots. Reel it in steadily.","questAmethystLensSawfish":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]","questAmethystLensSawfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]. Mind its nose! It fights hard all the way in from Kelpwood\'s channels.","questAmethystLensSturgeon":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]","questAmethystLensOarfish":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]","questAmethystLensSturgeonDescription":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]. The oldest fish in Kelpwood, and a shy one.","questAmethystLensOarfishDescription":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]. Long as a jetty and rarely seen. Keep casting in Kelpwood\'s water, and it will come.","questMoonwellLensEel":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]","questMoonwellLensEelDescription":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]. It crackles with light of its own down in the shoals. Just the thing for a lens!","questMoonwellLensDarter":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]","questMoonwellLensDarterDescription":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]. Quick as a shadow between the crystals. Watch your float closely.","questMoonwellLensMoray":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]","questMoonwellLensMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]. It hides in the crystal cracks and bites hard when it does.","questMoonwellLensDragonfish":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]","questMoonwellLensGiantMoray":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]","questMoonwellLensDragonfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]. It shines like moonlight on the Amethyst shoals.","questMoonwellLensGiantMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]. The biggest hunter in the shoals, and the rarest bite of all. Patience, friend.","questTheHushName":"The Hush","questTheHushDescription":"Three lenses lit, and still the Lamp won\'t wake fully. That\'s the Hush, friend. It\'s no curse, only a great old fish that fell asleep in the Moonwell when the light went out, and the whole Reach went quiet with it. Will you call it up for me? Gently, now. It only needs waking.","questTheHushCall":"Wait for the Hush in the Moonwell without reeling in","questTheHushCallDescription":"Cast into the Moonwell, north across the bridge from the Lamp, and keep still while you wait: a tap or click reels the line in. When the Hush rises, tap to bring it up and it will swim home.","questTheHushReturn":"Return to Stinky","questTheHushReturnDescription":"The Hush is home in the deep again. Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questTheHushCompleted":"There! Do you see it? The whole Lamp is shining, friend, brighter than I\'ve seen it since I was young. The Hush was never our enemy. It only needed someone patient enough to call it up and let it be. Take these five Glowtide Flares, and fish the Moonwell whenever you like. That old fish may come up to say hello.","questLanternReachMailName":"News of the Lantern Reach","questLanternReachMailDescription":"There you are! The portal to the Lantern Reach can finally be opened. Blubberbeard grew up out there, and he\'s been staring at that portal all week. Go and ask him about it!","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReach":"Ask Blubberbeard about the Lantern Reach","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReachDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and take on his task to reach the Lantern Reach.","kelpwoodResidentQuestGreeting":"There you are, dear. I was hoping you\'d drift by.","kelpwoodResidentInventoryFull":"Your pockets are full, dear. Make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I owe you.","questLostPoolName":"The Lost Pool","questLostPoolDescription":"When I was young, dear, there was a pool hidden among these roots, where the kelp meets the cliff. The wisps still whisper of it. Would you find it and catch 3 fish there? I\'d so like to know it\'s still alive.","questLostPoolCatch":"Catch 3 fish in Kelpwood\'s hidden pool","questLostPoolCatchDescription":"Search Kelpwood\'s west rim, behind the trees on the far side from its bridge, for a crack of hidden water. Cast into it and land 3 fish.","questLostPoolReturn":"Return to Auntie Glenda","questLostPoolReturnDescription":"The old pool is still full of fish. Go and tell Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots.","questLostPoolCompleted":"Still full of fish, after all these years... Thank you, dear. I feel a little lighter, as if the mist has thinned. Take these Glowtide Flares, and the [[Gold Coin]] that washed into my roots.","kelpwoodResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp? Oh, dear, I haven\'t been to one in a hundred years. I\'ll drift across the water as soon as the lanterns are lit.","amethystResidentQuestGreeting":"You came back! I\'ve got a really important job for you.","amethystResidentInventoryFull":"Your bag\'s too full! Make some room, then come back. I\'ve got something for you!","questPerfectPitchName":"Perfect Pitch","questPerfectPitchDescription":"When the Lamp\'s beam shines on my crystals, the fish swim up to listen! I want to hear them sing. Catch 3 fish where the beam touches the Amethyst water, and I\'ll tune to their song.","questPerfectPitchCatch":"Catch 3 fish where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water","questPerfectPitchCatchDescription":"Find the column of light where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water. It drifts across the water and rests now and then, so cast into it and keep your float in its light until the bite. Land 3 fish bitten there.","questPerfectPitchReturn":"Return to Urchin","questPerfectPitchReturnDescription":"The shoal sang in the beam\'s light. Go and tell Urchin by his dock hut.","questPerfectPitchCompleted":"Listen... every crystal is singing the same song! You did it! Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]]. And tell Stinky he still hums flat. Don\'t say it was me!","amethystResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival? With music?! I\'ll tune every crystal on the shoals. Can I stay up for the lanterns?","moonwellResidentQuestGreeting":"Softly... oh, it\'s you. Come and sit by the well.","moonwellResidentInventoryFull":"Your pack is full... make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I promised.","questGlowtideLullabyName":"Glowtide Lullaby","questGlowtideLullabyDescription":"When the glowtide drifts over the Moonwell, the sleeping fish rise to dream in its glow. Would you catch 40 of them there for me? Then I\'ll know what they\'re dreaming, and what to sing.","questGlowtideLullabyCatch":"Catch 40 fish in a glowtide bloom on the Moonwell","questGlowtideLullabyCatchDescription":"Find a glowing glowtide bloom on the Moonwell\'s water, cast into it and land 40 fish while your float is in its glow. A Glowtide Flare calls up a bloom of your own.","questGlowtideLullabyReturn":"Return to Hesper","questGlowtideLullabyReturnDescription":"The Moonwell\'s fish rose to the glow. Go and tell Hesper at the Moonwell.","questGlowtideLullabyCompleted":"They dream of the light... every one of them. I\'ll sing them something new tonight. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and keep the Moonwell glowing.","moonwellResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp... I\'ll bring my lantern, and sing the fish to sleep after. Wake me if I doze off.","pimLampFestivalInvited":"A festival?! At the Lamp?! I\'ll hang the bunting! I\'ll bake! Oh, I\'ve waited my whole life for this!","questLampFestivalInvitedBlubberbeard":"A festival at the Lamp, and old Stinky asked for me? ...Tell him I\'ll be there, matey. It\'s high time I went home.","questLampFestivalName":"The Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalDescription":"The whole Lamp is shining, friend, and every island is awake again. Time we had a Lamp Festival, like the ones I knew as a boy! Will you invite everyone for me? Start with Auntie Glenda, over on Kelpwood.","questLampFestivalRose":"Invite Rose to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalRoseDescription":"Back to the harbour now. Find Rose by her Tide Ledger and invite her to the Lamp Festival. She\'ll want to bake.","questLampFestivalGlenda":"Invite Auntie Glenda to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalGlendaDescription":"Find Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots, west across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalChime":"Invite Urchin to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalChimeDescription":"Find Urchin by his dock hut on the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge, and invite him to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalHesper":"Invite Hesper to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalHesperDescription":"Find Hesper at the Moonwell, north across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalBlubberbeard":"Invite Blubberbeard to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalBlubberbeardDescription":"Everyone in the Reach is coming. Go back through the portal to the Hub, find Blubberbeard by his shack, and invite him home to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalReturn":"Return to Stinky","questLampFestivalReturnDescription":"Blubberbeard is coming home! Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questLampFestivalCompleted":"Blubberbeard\'s coming home? Oh, friend... I never stopped keeping a light on for him. Look at the Reach tonight: every island lit, and all of us together again. You did this. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and come to every festival we ever have.","keeperWickHushWaitShh":"Shh... Keep still and let the line rest, friend.","keeperWickHushWaitStill":"Still now. Something old is stirring...","keeperWickHushWaitNearly":"Nearly... It\'s rising to you.","keeperWickHushWaitAbandoned":"Shh... it\'s still close. Cast again and keep still.","keeperWickHushReelLost":"Oh! It slipped back down, friend. Cast again, it\'s still close.","keeperWickHushWaitInterrupted":"The Hush is still close, friend. Cast again when you\'re ready.","keeperWickKeepersChairLocked":"Not yet, friend. The Keeper\'s Chair waits until the whole Lamp is awake.","keeperWickKeepersChairWelcome":"Sit a while, friend. Turn the Lamp toward any water you\'ve lit, and it will shine a little kinder there, just for you.","keepersChairTitle":"Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairClose":"Close the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairPrompt":"Sit in the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairRopeUp":"Climb to the lantern room","keepersChairRopeDown":"Climb down","keepersChairKelpwood":"Kelpwood","keepersChairAmethyst":"Amethyst Shoals","keepersChairMoonwell":"Moonwell","keepersChairAim":"Aim the Lamp","keepersChairAimLabel":"Aim the Lamp at {{island}}","keepersChairAimed":"Lamp aimed","keepersChairRest":"Rest the Lamp","keepersChairDark":"Lens still dark","keepersChairTideNotice":"Today\'s Tide Notice","keepersChairFavour":"Aimed water: blooms hold more rares and last longer, and the Tide Notice fish bites more often.","keepersChairAimedStatus":"The Lamp shines on {{island}}.","keepersChairRestedStatus":"The Lamp rests, shining on every island alike.","keepersChairTooFar":"Climb to the lantern room to aim the Lamp.","keepersChairNotRelit":"Relight that island\'s lens first.","keeperWickReachLogWelcome":"My old logbook, friend. It smells of bait, like me! Land the biggest of each fish and I\'ll ink it in, bright as a beam.","keeperWickReachLogPageGold":"A whole page in gold! Not even the Lamp shines that bright. Take these three Glowtide Flares, friend.","keeperWickLampLightWelcome":"Every fish you let go leaves a little light behind, friend. The Lamp keeps it safe for you.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseKelpwood":"A Kelpwood fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight Kelpwood\'s lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseAmethyst":"An Amethyst Shoals fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight their lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseMoonwell":"A Moonwell fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight the Moonwell\'s lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWatersAllFound":"Every hidden water in the Reach! Even I\'d forgotten one or two. Each keeps a piece. Win any you are missing, then come back to me.","questMagmawardPlateDescription":"Cross the bridge east of the plains to the Tower of Doom. Bring them back to Elder Ashborn at the outpost.","questMagmawardCompleted":"Every piece, earned. Beat one of each on your way up.","questTowerOfDoomSquireDescription":"Cinder Squires hold the Tower of Doom\'s ground hall. When one lifts its burning hammer, step out of the ring before it comes down, and keep out of the fire it leaves.","questTowerOfDoomBruteDescription":"A Gauntlet Brute waits on the mezzanine above the Tower of Doom\'s hall. When it claps, jump the shockwave as it rolls across the floor.","questTowerOfDoomCuratorDescription":"Glass Curators keep the Tower of Doom\'s library, further up. If one shuts you in a glass case, hit the glass to break out.","questTowerOfDoomClimbDescription":"The seals are broken. Climb the rest of the stairs to Holt in the wizard room, beside the grey portal to the roof.","questTowerOfDoomRoofDescription":"Take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof and defeat the Doom Warlord.","questTowerOfDoomReportDescription":"The Warlord is down! Go back to Holt in the Tower of Doom\'s wizard room. The roof\'s portal takes you straight to him.","questTowerOfDoomCompleted":"Back in one piece, and with the Warlord\'s own Chestplate. Not many walk off that roof. The Warlord\'ll be back up there by tomorrow, mind. It always is.","questDailyTowerDescription":"The Doom Warlord\'s back on my roof. It always comes back. Climb up and knock it down again.","questDailyTowerClimbDescription":"Climb the Tower of Doom, or Holt\'s rope if it\'s yours, and take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof. Defeat the Doom Warlord.","questDailyTowerReportDescription":"Down it goes again! Take the roof\'s portal back down and tell Kade at the tower door.","questDailyTowerCompleted":"Good. That holds it for a day. Same again tomorrow?","questDailyTowerDone":"You\'ve done your climb for today. Bring me 20.","questHoltsRopeRivetsCollect":"Collect 20 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]","questHoltsRopeRivetsErrand":"Defeat the Warlord\'s guards on the Tower of Doom\'s stairs for Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]. Give it a tug and up you come, straight to me, no stairs.","questWordOfATraderName":"Word of a Trader","questWordOfATraderDescription":"Rope\'s yours, so here\'s something for nothing. Climbers talk of a trader out at the edge of the world who sells things you won\'t find anywhere else. Word is, one of this tower\'s windows lets out that way. Have a look on your way down.","questWordOfATraderWindow":"Find the window out of the Tower of Doom","questWordOfATraderWindowDescription":"One of the Tower of Doom\'s windows, a few floors up, has a way out. Look around for it.","questWordOfATraderSmuglyn":"Find Smuglyn, the trader at the edge of the world","questWordOfATraderSmuglynDescription":"The way out leads to the edge of the world. Find Smuglyn and see what he sells.","questWordOfATraderCompleted":"Ah, someone who knows the back way in. Here, 5 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]] on the house, to start you off. My wares change every day. After the MAGMAWARD GAUNTLETS? They\'re mine to give! Earn \'em! The pit\'s crawling with scorpions. Take these Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]]: chuck one in and my mortar does the rest. BOOM! Thin out 50 for me!","questScorpPitHuntDescription":"Throw a Mortar Strike [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] into the Scorp Pit to bring Grizzlefuse\'s mortar down on it, or fight with your own weapon. Defeat 50 scorpions.","questScorpPitReportDescription":"That\'s 50! Step on the grey portal in the pit\'s floor to get back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.","questScorpPitCompleted":"KA-BOOM! Did you see \'em fly? Beautiful! Here, spotter: the Magmaward Gauntlets. Dug \'em out of the pit after a big one. Still warm! And take these Interdimensional Mortar Strikes [[Purple Firecracker Pebble]]. Throw one anywhere, ANYWHERE, and my shells come raining down through a rift right over it!","questDailyScorpDescription":"They\'ve bred back, spotter! Fresh Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]], same job. You mark \'em, I shell \'em!","questDailyScorpHuntDescription":"Defeat 10 scorpions in the Scorp Pit, with Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] or your own weapon.","questDailyScorpReportDescription":"Pit\'s thinned! Take the grey portal in the pit\'s floor back up and tell Grizzlefuse.","questDailyScorpCompleted":"Ha ha! Lovely shooting, spotter. Here, more Interdimensional Mortar Strikes [[Purple Firecracker Pebble]]. Same again?","questScorpPitName":"The Scorp Pit","questScorpPitHunt":"Defeat 50 scorpions in the Scorp Pit","questDailyScorpHunt":"Defeat 10 scorpions in the Scorp Pit","questGrizzlefuseFuelName":"The Pit\'s Flask","questGrizzlefuseFuelDescription":"Spotter! Those thieving scorpions nicked my Splash Poison Potions [[Splash Poison Potion]] and buried \'em in their egg piles! Find me 5 and my spare Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] is yours. Deal? DEAL!","questGrizzlefuseFuelFind":"Find 5 Splash Poison Potions [[Splash Poison Potion]] in the Scorp Pit\'s egg piles","questGrizzlefuseFuelFindDescription":"Jump down into the Scorp Pit and dig a whole stack of eggs out of its big egg piles. Take the grey portal in the pit\'s floor back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.","questGrizzlefuseFuelCompleted":"All 5 found? Ha ha! Those scorpions\'ll be fuming! Here, spotter: one Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Wear the whole set and it burns up the second lava touches you. Good. Here. One Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. Return to Mortimus in its hall.","questDailyCryptCompleted":"You walked out of the dark once more. The crypt is stirring, but ask me again in a moment and I will send you down once more.","questSlayVulcanDescription":"You came through the fire? I\'m Ember. I felt a crack open in the world and followed it down. It\'s Lord Vulcan\'s doing, a wizard gone bad. He\'s been tearing it open from his tower at the bottom of the rift, and my fire only feeds him. His spells come in time, like a drum. Learn the beat and you can beat him. Bring friends if you can.","questSlayVulcanFightDescription":"Defeat Lord Vulcan in the ring at the bottom of the Molten Rift. His big spells come in time: step with the beat, or get out of the ring until they pass. Anyone fighting him beside you shares the win.","questSlayVulcanReportDescription":"Lord Vulcan is beaten! Tell Ember at the rift\'s southern edge.","questSlayVulcanCompleted":"You did it! Lord Vulcan is beaten, and the crack has gone quiet. But it isn\'t the only one. More are opening all over the land, and he wasn\'t working alone. Mortimus keeps the Shuffling Crypt there.","questMagmawardTreads":"Win the Magmaward Boots from Mortimus at the Shuffling Crypt","questShootingGalleryDescription":"I keep the Magmaward Leggings, old armour made for wading through lava. Earn them the way I did, starting small. Magma Golems climb those ribs out there. Take these 25 Pebbles [[Pebble]] and knock 3 of them into the lava.","questShootingGalleryPebblesDescription":"Throw Pebbles [[Pebble]] at the Magma Golems standing on the ends of the skeleton\'s ribs in the lava basin. Knock 3 of them off. Run out? Flint has more.","questShootingGalleryShootDescription":"Flint\'s Gallery Bow and Arrows [[Arrow]] are yours now. Shoot the Magma Golems on the skeleton\'s ribs and knock 6 of them off. Lost the bow? Flint has another.","questShootingGalleryPunchDescription":"Throw a Fireball [[Fireball]] at your feet to blast yourself up onto one of the skeleton\'s ribs, then knock 3 Magma Golems off up close, with your fists or a sword. Every golem that falls drops Fireballs [[Fireball]].","questShootingGalleryReportDescription":"Three rounds, three ways. Head back to Flint in her booth at the end of the skull\'s tunnel.","questShootingGalleryCompleted":"Up on the ribs, toe to toe with them. Bold. The Magmaward Leggings are yours. They\'ve waded through that lava more times than I can count.","questDailyGalleryDescription":"The golems are back on the ribs. Fresh Arrows [[Arrow]], same targets. Let\'s see if you\'ve gone rusty.","questDailyGalleryShootDescription":"Knock 6 Magma Golems off the skeleton\'s ribs in the lava basin, by shot, throw or punch. Lost Flint\'s Gallery Bow? She has another.","questDailyGalleryReportDescription":"That\'s six. Tell Flint in her booth.","questDailyGalleryCompleted":"Not bad at all. Same time tomorrow.","questDailyGalleryDone":"That\'s your practice done for today. Rest your arm.","questShootingGalleryName":"The Shooting Gallery","questShootingGalleryShoot":"Knock 6 Magma Golems off the skeleton\'s ribs","questShootingGalleryPebbles":"Knock 3 Magma Golems off with Pebbles [[Pebble]]","questShootingGalleryArrows":"Knock 6 Magma Golems off with Arrows [[Arrow]]","questShootingGalleryPunch":"Blast up onto a rib and knock 3 Magma Golems off up close","questShootingGalleryReport":"Return to Flint at the Shooting Gallery","questDailyGalleryName":"Target Practice","questGalleryFuelName":"Fireballs for Fuel","questGalleryFuelDescription":"Those golems drop Fireballs [[Fireball]] when they fall. My gains are wasting away up here.","questGlassBroProteinReminder":"{{remaining}} more Cow\'s Milk [[Cow\'s Milk]], bro. So close to hitting my protein.","questGlassBroProteinCompleted":"A hundred? Bro. That\'s a whole day of protein. You\'re a legend, and you didn\'t even get eaten.","questGlassBroProteinDone":"Protein\'s hit for today, bro. Same again tomorrow?
